title: Saidwire Recognizer Options
description: Saidwire realtime STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'saidwire'. Saidwire is English only, one audio channel per stream.

apiKey.description: Saidwire API key. Overrides the key configured in jambonz.

endpointing.description: Milliseconds of silence (at least 500) before a final transcript, or false to disable. Keep it set: without it turns may not end.

utteranceEndMs.description: Milliseconds of silence before an UtteranceEnd message is sent.

vadEvents.description: Send SpeechStarted events when speech begins.
